knowledge:
- key_parameters: file=Path to the input indexed BAM file of the FFPE sample ;; threads=Number of threads to use for parallel processing ;; FFPEReadsFile=Path to the output text file where identified FFPE artifact chimeric read names will be written ;; dupChimFile=Path to the output text file where read names of PCR or optical duplicates of chimeric reads will be written ;; readsToFilter=Vector of read names (artifact chimeric reads and duplicate chimeric reads) to be filtered out ;; destination=Path to the output filtered BAM file ;; overwrite=Logical value indicating whether to overwrite the destination file if it already exists
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing NGS data from FFPE samples, specifically prior to calling structural variations (SVs), to eliminate false positive SV calls caused by artificial chimeric reads.
- pitfalls: The input BAM file must be indexed. PCR or optical duplicates should be marked or removed from the BAM file before running FilterFFPE. Do not filter reads by mapping quality or restrict to targeted regions before running FilterFFPE, as these steps can remove alignments crucial to the filtering algorithm; perform those steps after using FilterFFPE.

workflows.name: artifact_chimeric_read_filtration
workflows.intent: Find and filter artificial chimeric reads and their duplicates from an FFPE BAM file to prepare it for downstream structural variation calling.
input: file.bam (indexed BAM file of the FFPE sample with PCR/optical duplicates marked or removed)
workflows.stages: 1. Find artifact chimeric reads and duplicate chimeric reads using findArtifactChimericReads ;; 2. Filter the BAM file by read names using filterBamByReadNames ;; 3. Alternatively, perform both finding and filtering in a single step using FFPEReadFilter ;; 4. Verify the filtered BAM file using Rsamtools::scanBam
workflows.code:
file <- system.file("extdata", "example.bam", package = "FilterFFPE")
outFolder <- tempdir()
FFPEReadsFile <- paste0(outFolder, "/example.FFPEReads.txt")
dupChimFile <- paste0(outFolder, "/example.dupChim.txt")
artifactReads <- findArtifactChimericReads(file = file, threads = 2,
                                           FFPEReadsFile = FFPEReadsFile,
                                           dupChimFile = dupChimFile)
head(artifactReads)

dupChim <- readLines(dupChimFile)
readsToFilter <- c(artifactReads, dupChim)
destination <- paste0(outFolder, "/example.FilterFFPE.bam")
filterBamByReadNames(file = file, readsToFilter = readsToFilter,
                     destination = destination, overwrite=TRUE)

file <- system.file("extdata", "example.bam", package = "FilterFFPE")
outFolder <- tempdir()
FFPEReadsFile <- paste0(outFolder, "/example.FFPEReads.txt")
dupChimFile <- paste0(outFolder, "/example.dupChim.txt")
destination <- paste0(outFolder, "/example.FilterFFPE.bam")
FFPEReadFilter(file = file, threads=2, destination = destination,
               overwrite=TRUE, FFPEReadsFile = FFPEReadsFile,
               dupChimFile = dupChimFile)

newBam <- Rsamtools::scanBam(destination)
head(newBam[[1]]$seq)
